spanish: Y mañana, y verán gloria de Jehová, en su oír las murmuraciones de ustedes sobre Jehová; y nosotros, ¿qué, que murmuran ustedes sobre nosotros?

findings.issue: «Y mañana» is the next-day adverb. The token is the absolute noun בֹּקֶר (morning), not a word for the following day.

«murmuran ustedes» adds an unmarked finite verb and an explicit 2nd-person subject between כִּי and עָלֵינוּ. No packet token is a verb of murmuring; the only murmuring token is the plural noun תְּלֻנֹּתֵיכֶם, object of the infinitive.

notes: The rest of the clause tracks the packet, including both waws, Jehová, the 3ms infinitive, and the 2mp suffix on the noun.
